name: 地质（图件/剖面/柱状）生成

map.地质柱状图按地层由上至下（由新到老）排列：层厚 = 顶界深度 − 底界深度，累计: A geological column arranges strata from top to bottom (youngest to oldest): layer thickness = top boundary depth − bottom boundary depth, cumulative thickness = Σ layer thicknesses; the scale converts to drawn length = actual thickness ÷ scale denominator (e.g. at 1:1000, 1 m is drawn as 1 mm); the section is drawn on a strike- and dip-oriented cut, and the attitude is defined by the three elements strike, dip angle and dip direction, with dip angle = arctan(vertical drop ÷ horizontal distance).
map.📚 深度解析：地质柱状图/剖面图文本生成: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Geological Column/Section Text Generation
map.编录成图：把钻孔或地层编录数据转成可复制的柱状图文本，直接贴入报告: Log-to-map: convert borehole or strata logging data into copyable column text for direct pasting into a report
map.教学示意：快速生成标准分层柱状，辅助野外教学与课件: Teaching illustration: quickly generate a standard layered column to aid field teaching and courseware
map.资料整理：批量输出多个钻孔的岩性序列，统一归档格式: Data organisation: output the lithology sequences of several boreholes in a unified archive format
map.用法：按从上到下的顺序录入各地层（岩性、厚度、符号等），工具按层序渲染柱状/剖面: Usage: enter each stratum from top to bottom (lithology, thickness, symbol, etc.) and the tool renders the column/section text in layer order. It is recommended to note the lithology, thickness (m) and main markers (such as fossils, mineralisation) for each layer; a single layer is commonly 0.5-5 m thick and the total is often 10-30 m, with thickness units unified to m (generated locally, not uploaded).
map.例：录入 5 层——砂岩 2.0m、泥岩 3.0m、灰岩 5.0m、页岩 1.0: Example: enter 5 layers — sandstone 2.0 m, mudstone 3.0 m, limestone 5.0 m, shale 1.0 m, basalt 4.0 m, total thickness 15.0 m; the tool generates top-down column text and labels the cumulative depth on each layer (2/5/10/11/15 m).
map.生成的是图片还是文本？: Does it generate an image or text?
map.本工具输出的是结构化文本柱状，便于直接复制进 Word/LaTeX 报告；如需矢: This tool outputs a structured text column, easy to copy directly into Word/LaTeX reports; for a vector graphic, redraw it in GIS or professional column software in the same layer order.
map.不能。所有层厚须统一为同一单位（建议 m），否则累计深度与柱状比例会失真。: No. All layer thicknesses must use the same unit (m recommended), otherwise the cumulative depth and the column scale are distorted.
